plan.gst_hst_credit.action: File your tax return every year, even with no income. Newcomers can apply with form RC151.
plan.otb.action: File your Ontario return and fill in the ON-BEN form with your rent or property tax.
plan.cwb.action: Claim it on your tax return (Schedule 6). You can get part of it in advance.
plan.ccb.action: Apply through your CRA account or form RC66. Newcomers need a SIN first.
plan.ocb.action: Nothing extra to do: it comes with the Canada Child Benefit.
plan.resp_cesg.action: Open an RESP at a bank or credit union and contribute. The grant is added to the plan.
plan.clb.action: Open an RESP for your child; the bond needs no contribution.
plan.child_care_deduction.action: Keep receipts and claim on form T778 with your tax return.
plan.cdcp.action: Check the current eligibility rules and apply online or by phone.
plan.first_tax_return.action: File for your first year in Canada. It unlocks most benefits.
plan.sin_credit_building.action: Get your SIN at Service Canada, then build credit with a small, fully paid card.
plan.tuition_credit.action: Get your T2202 from your school and claim it on your return.
plan.osap.action: Apply on the OSAP website for this school year.
plan.canada_training_credit.action: File your return each year to build room; claim it when you pay for training.
plan.student_loan_interest.action: Claim the interest on your return (line 31900). Unused amounts carry forward.
plan.hst_registration.action: Use the HST calculator here with your last four quarters, then register if required.
plan.cpp_self_employed.action: CPP is calculated on your return (Schedule 8). Set money aside during the year.
plan.tax_instalments.action: Watch for an instalment reminder from the CRA and pay by the due dates.
plan.home_vehicle_expenses.action: Track business use of your home and car; claim on form T2125.
plan.ei_self_employed.action: You must opt in before you need the benefits. Read the conditions first.

plan.tfsa.title: Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA)
plan.fhsa.title: First Home Savings Account (FHSA)
plan.tfsa.action: Check your exact room in CRA My Account before contributing. Over-contributing is taxed.
plan.fhsa.action: Room only starts the year you open one. Opening early starts the clock even if you don't deposit yet.
reason.tfsa_has_room_check_cra: You have a TFSA. Confirm your room before adding more.
reason.tfsa_room_accumulates_unused: Room has been building up for you, even without an account.
reason.fhsa_open_room_check: You have an FHSA. Confirm your room before adding more.
reason.fhsa_room_starts_when_opened: Room only starts building once you open one.
reason.resp_catch_up_possible: Unused grant room can still be caught up.
reason.resp_age_cutoff_soon: Contribute before the end of the year your child turns 15 to keep grants available at 16 and 17.
